1.?

For the parametric curve x=t−4,y=1−2t2,0≤t≤4, consider the following table of values:

t 0 1 2 3 4
x a −3 −2 −1 0
y 1 −1 b c −31

Find the value of a+b+c.

E
Sun, Aug 9th @ 1:21 PM|Elapsed: 1:08Correct

  • To find the value of a, we substitute t=0 into x=t−4. This gives a=0−4=−4.

  • To find the value of b, we substitute t=2 into y=1−2t2. This gives b=1−2(2)2=−7.

  • To find the value of c, we substitute t=3 into y=1−2t2. This gives c=1−2(3)2=−17

Finally, we have a+b+c=−4+(−7)+(−17)=−28.
